correctness.rationale: The physically correct pair event for earlier card i and later card j is 1{S_i>S_j}+1{S_i=S_j}B_j. Its nonsymmetric conditional projections are A_i and -A_j+C_j with variances u=(m²-1)/(12m²), v=p(1-p)/m², leaving a doubly degenerate pair residual. Summing yields linear weights k-2j+1 and j-1; the first weights sum to zero, giving Cov(Ik,Il)=Var(Ik) for every k<=l, including exact formula [u k(k-1)(2k+5)+v k(k-1)(2k-1)]/6. Degenerate residual is martingale with maximal L²=O(n²), negligible on n^3 scale. Two-component Donsker maps to Gaussian ∫(t-2r)dWA+∫r dWC whose covariance (u+v)min(s,t)^3/3; hence σ W(t³). Independently brute-forced physical shelves with rational probabilities m=2, p=1/3 up to n=4, reproducing all nested covariances. No finite test substitutes for functional convergence proof.
